unresolvedGaps.summary: Downgraded from VERIFIED to PARTIAL in the internal audit pass, and the SRC-NIST-SP811-CH4 candidate source and its claim were REMOVED, for two independent defects. (1) AUTHORITY CLASS: SRC-NIST-SP811-CH4 is registered as PRIMARY_NORMATIVE_OR_STANDARDS_BODY, but this requirement's frozen sourceAuthorityClasses are ACADEMIC_OR_RESEARCH_INSTITUTION, PROFESSIONAL_BODY, AUTHORITATIVE_TECHNICAL_REFERENCE and AUTHORITATIVE_EDUCATIONAL_REFERENCE -- the cited class is not permitted for this requirement. (2) PASSAGE-TO-CLAIM SUPPORT: its recorded passage ('Derived units are expressed algebraically in terms of base units or other derived units', plus a table of m^2, m^3, m/s^2) does not support the claim attributed to it, which was about multiplying/dividing by power-of-ten SI prefix factors. That claim also embedded an internal cross-reference to Batch 01's FM-LP-19, which is a curriculum decision, not something NIST attests.

No single retrieved passage states both that the quantity in question is RESISTIVITY and that its SI unit symbol is the ohm-metre. The claim is established by compounding two genuine NIST passages: SRC-NIST-RESHALL supplies 'rho = sample resistivity (in ohm-cm)' (linking resistivity to an ohm-length unit) and SRC-NIST-SP811-B9's conversion table supplies the SI form 'ohm meter (Ohm-m)'. Downgraded from VERIFIED to PARTIAL in the internal audit pass to match this batch's own statusVocabulary, which defines PARTIAL as including a claim that 'rests on a disclosed compounding of more than one passage where no single passage states the full claim'. The compounding was already disclosed in the scopeNote; only the status was inconsistent with it.

Downgraded from VERIFIED to PARTIAL in the internal audit pass. The previously recorded retrievedPassage for SRC-ETW-POWERTRIANGLE ('Power (P): Measured in watts, represents actual work performed by the resistive component' vs 'Power Factor: A unitless ratio describing the phase relationship between voltage and current, determining how efficiently that power is delivered.') was NOT present on the source page. It was synthesised summary prose recorded inside a verbatim-quotation field. The page was re-fetched during the audit and the field now holds what the page actually says. The dimensionless/no-unit property -- the batch's own technical guardrail -- is NOT stated in terms by this source; it is a disclosed INFERENCE from the page's own P/S = W/VA identity (the watt units cancel). Retained as an inference rather than deleted, because it is correct and the sibling UNIT_SYMBOL result derives it the same honest way, but it is not a retrieved passage and the requirement is therefore not fully VERIFIED on retrieved text alone.

Downgraded from VERIFIED to PARTIAL in the internal audit pass, for the same fabricated-quotation defect recorded on the sibling power::DISTINCTION result: the previously recorded 'A unitless ratio describing the phase relationship...' passage does not exist on the source page (confirmed by re-fetch during the audit). The dimensionlessness of power factor is retained as a disclosed inference from the page's own P/S = W/VA identity, not as retrieved text. NOTE FOR PRODUCT ARCHITECT: this is the batch's power-factor guardrail, and it currently rests on inference rather than on an explicit authoritative statement. A source that states dimensionlessness in terms (e.g. IEC 60050 / IEEE) should be acquired before this is treated as settled.

Downgraded from VERIFIED to PARTIAL in the internal audit pass. The previously recorded retrievedPassage ('inductance is a fixed property of a coil...whereas inductive reactance depends on AC frequency...reactance is dynamic and frequency-dependent, whereas inductance itself remains constant regardless of the applied signal frequency') was NOT present on the source page; it was synthesised prose in a verbatim-quotation field, and ACQUISITION-LOG.json repeated it as fact. The proposition actually carrying the DISTINCTION dimension -- that inductance itself is frequency-independent while reactance is not -- is therefore UNEVIDENCED in this batch. What the page genuinely supports (reactance depends on both inductance and frequency) is retained. NOTE: the parallel capacitance DISTINCTION result is NOT affected -- its passage ('Unlike resistance which has a fixed value... Capacitive Reactance varies inversely proportional with the applied frequency') was confirmed genuine, so the two are not symmetrical in evidential quality despite having been written as though they were.

Downgraded from VERIFIED to PARTIAL in the internal audit pass: no sentence from the source was ever reproduced for this requirement, so the requirement's own acceptance criterion ('the exact passage must be actually read and cited, never inferred') is not met on the record as it stands. The underlying fact is not in doubt and the same source genuinely supports the sibling safe-use PROCEDURE requirement with real quoted text; what is missing is a retrieved passage for this specific DEFINITION requirement. Resolving this needs only a re-fetch and one quoted sentence -- deliberately NOT done by inference during the audit.

Downgraded from VERIFIED to PARTIAL in the internal audit pass. This requirement declares two coverage dimensions, PROCEDURE and CALCULATION_METHOD; the evidence ('Step 1. Turn Off Power to Circuit'; 'If a circuit includes a capacitor, discharge the capacitor before taking any resistance reading') delivers a genuine PROCEDURE but contains no calculation of any kind. CALCULATION_METHOD had been marked satisfied with an empty unresolvedDimensions list purely because the requirementMode is PROCEDURE_COVERAGE -- a false green. It is now recorded as unresolved. NOTE FOR PRODUCT ARCHITECT: this may instead be a plan-level artefact (a safe-use principle arguably has no calculation dimension to satisfy). That is a judgment about the frozen plan, which this pass has no authority to amend, so the honest unresolved marking is used instead.

Downgraded from VERIFIED to PARTIAL in the internal audit pass. The requirement is 'energy meter measures/INTEGRATES electrical energy', but the sole retrieved passage is the single sentence 'Electrical energy usage is measured with watt-hour meters.' NISTIR 8248 as quoted states nothing about an integration mechanism, and nothing about contrasting accumulated energy with instantaneous power. The integration half of the requirement is therefore UNEVIDENCED. The previous record also carried the acquirer's own gloss INSIDE the retrievedPassage field -- '(context: distinguishing this accumulated-usage measurement from the instantaneous power measurements discussed in the same paragraph)' -- which has been removed; retrievedPassage is a verbatim-quotation field. The accumulation/integration property remains derivable from the already-evidenced energy = power x time relationship (EQCT-LP-06), but that is an internal derivation, not this source's statement.
